Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase, with >100,000 CFU/mL Citrobacter freundii complex in culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of targeted antibiotic therapy.
